**Comparability:** Both figures come from the same filing and cover the same fiscal-year basis (years ended June 30), so FY2023 and FY2024 are directly comparable [DOC-1].

**Calculation**

FY2024: Revenue $245,122M − cost of revenue $74,114M = gross profit $171,008M; gross margin = 171,008 / 245,122 = **69.76%** [DOC-1]

FY2023: Revenue $211,915M − cost of revenue $65,863M = gross profit $146,052M; gross margin = 146,052 / 211,915 = **68.92%** [DOC-1]

**Change:** 69.76% − 68.92% = **+0.84 percentage points** — an improvement. Revenue grew ~15.7% ($211,915M → $245,122M) while cost of revenue grew ~12.5% ($65,863M → $74,114M), so costs rose more slowly than sales, expanding the margin [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Improved by approximately 0.84 percentage points (68.92% in FY2023 to 69.76% in FY2024)
